subject: de-sptl
title: DE.SPTL.------ALT.FT.
description: Chart 2 of 3 on book p. 286 (PR.S(RD)II-40). DE-SPTL (despiritualization) is the subject; ALT-FT (alternative functionalism) is the partner. From the subject: INFO-DY, EXP-CONT-2 (expansion condition (isolated focus)) and EXTN-OB (existential observation). From INFO-DY: BSCI. From BSCI: IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics) and METH. From EXP-CONT-2: INDIV-TD (individual tendencies). From EXTN-OB: PART (participation). From PART: INFO-COMP (information compression) and PER-PHY-U-FUND (perceived physical universe fundamental).
